description: Versioned post-hoc valuation assumptions. Measured ledger rows remain immutable; all dollar, energy, and carbon figures are regenerated from those measurements plus this file and resource_valuation_model_pricing_20260817.csv.
scope: Operational LLM serving only. Excludes training, embodied hardware, client devices, network energy, and other lifecycle effects.

serving_stack.scenario_semantics: Arrays are [low, central, high] scenarios, not confidence intervals.

cross_check_per_token.note: Independent simple per-token order-of-magnitude cross-check; cache reads and writes receive no serving-efficiency discount in this model.

anthropic_cache_write.central_assumption: All recorded Anthropic cache-creation tokens are valued at the public 5-minute cache-write rate (1.25x base input). The ledger does not record cache TTL.
anthropic_cache_write.note: The generated sensitivity total revalues all Anthropic cache writes at the 1-hour rate; it is a billing-assumption sensitivity, not a confidence interval.
